same_citation_query_probe.method: One direct NCBI ESearch request composed from the same public structured citation fields; this was not a full invocation of research.search_pubmed_query, which requires a caller-supplied contact email and performs an ESummary stage.

findings: An earlier source version and one direct ESearch query generated from the same public citation both reported PMID 2014248; the final-source recheck ended in NETWORK_ERROR and is preserved.
The direct ESearch probe was not a full research.search_pubmed_query invocation because that adapter requires a caller-supplied contact email and performs an ESummary stage.
This small probe does not measure bibliographic error rates, metadata quality, broad query recall, reliability, analyst time, or monetary cost; comparison remains COMPARISON_UNKNOWN.

research.search_pubmed_query retains its broader query-to-bounded-metadata scope, while research.resolve_pubmed_identifiers accepts DOI input; neither is shown to cover all useful citation-matching or query tasks.
No tool is retired, replaced, or promoted to Current from this evidence.
claim_ceiling: One earlier adapter source version and one direct ESearch probe returned the same PMID for a single public example; a final-source request failed with NETWORK_ERROR. This does not establish functional equivalence, comparative quality, cost superiority, source authenticity, citation correctness, or scientific support.
